answer: Rewards vest instead of paying out. An identity's earnings unlock linearly over 60 epochs, and whatever is still locked is burned if that identity is slashed. At the 45,000 POA floor payout, an identity that stays 60 epochs holds about 1.35 million POA locked, so 1,000 such fakes keep 1.35 billion POA at risk and lose it all when caught. Splitting across wallets cannot help, because each identity has its own locked balance. No knoll of fresh keys cashes out early, since pay on the ledge of unvested rewards cannot move. A short-lived fake earns almost nothing, a weak signal.
